uuss_yellowstone_1d.reference: Pang et al. (2019), GRL 46, supporting information Table S1: '1-D velocity model used by UUSS to locate earthquakes in the Yellowstone region'
uuss_yellowstone_1d.role: UUSS routine HYPOINVERSE model for Yellowstone (the model behind the ComCat reference locations); association, absolute location and reference-time derivation for the 2017 Maple Creek case
uuss_yellowstone_1d.derivation: Table S1 transcribed verbatim (Vp and Vs both tabulated; verified against the PDF text layer).
uuss_yellowstone_1d.vs_provenance: Tabulated in the source (Vp/Vs varies 1.60-1.66 by layer).
uuss_yellowstone_1d.depth_reference: Not stated in the source. Pang et al. report depths 'beneath the surface (mean elevation of 2.3 km)'; the datum of the layer tops is therefore taken as the local surface (~2.3 km ASL) until confirmed.

layer_semantics.published_representation: Depth to top of layer plus one constant velocity per layer (HYPOINVERSE layered model).
layer_semantics.grid_use: Layer tops with constant velocity below each top, as for the Ridgecrest and Magna registries.
